settings_experimental_intro: Ihe mgbakwunye ndị a na-edochi sistemụ adịbeghị anya, ndo ngosi, yana ntọala ngwa ngwa. Apụọ ha na ndabara n'ihi na ha anaghị arụ ọrụ nke ọma na ọtụtụ ekwentị.
settings_experimental_mad_windows: MAD Ịma Ọkwa na Ntọala ngwa ngwa windo
settings_experimental_mad_windows_off: Gbanyụọ: Ọkwa na-emepe ndo ngosi. Ntọala ngwa ngwa na-emepe ndò agbatịkwuru (otu ihe dị ka ịpị ala ugboro abụọ).
settings_experimental_mad_windows_on: Gbanye: Ozi, ngwa & Sistemu, yana Ntọala ngwa ngwa mepere MAD nke onwe windo kama ndo sistemụ.
settings_experimental_help_window_off: Gbanyụọ: /h ka edeziri n'okpuru Dezie dock/s → ActionBox Settings. Enweghị windo enyemaka na-ese n'elu mmiri.
settings_experimental_help_window_on: Na: /h na-emepe ndepụta iwu igbe ọrụ.
settings_experimental_widget_badges_off: Off: the MAD clock widget does not show unread app icons.
settings_experimental_widget_badges_on: On: unread app icons appear on the MAD clock widget.
settings_experimental_mad_recents_off: Gbanyụọ: Ndị na-adịbeghị anya (omume tuo na nso nso a) na-emepe nchịkọta ekwentị.
settings_experimental_mad_recents_on: Gbanye: Ihe na-adịbeghị anya na-emepe windo ngwa ngwa MAD nke na-adịbeghị anya. Nnweta ojiji juputara ndepụta sitere na ngwa ndị ọzọ.
settings_experimental_nav_shortcuts_off: Gbanyụọ: enweghị bọtịnụ machie na ogwe ụgbọ mmiri, na MAD anaghị egbochi taps nav. A na-echekwa ọnọdụ.
settings_experimental_nav_shortcuts_on: Gbanye: bọtịnụ machie na tap nav jiri ebe ị na-etinye. Dezie ha n'okpuru.
settings_experimental_need_grants_body: Nke a chọrọ ikike mgbakwunye. Mepee onyinye ọ bụla na-efu, wee laghachi ebe a. Kagbuo hapụ ya.
compat_upload_body: Aha nhọrọ, email na ndetu. Kwenye na-eziga .txt na .json na nchekwa mkpesa MAD GitHub.

setup_row_xiaomi_battery_why: HyperOS na-egbukarị ndị na-ege ntị n'azụ. Tọọ MAD na ojiji batrị anaghị egbochi ya.
compat_selftest_waiting: Mechaa ikike achọrọ n'elu - mgbe ahụ MAD na-eme nnwale onwe nke ndakọrịta ebe a.
compat_selftest_subtitle: Na-enyere MAD aka ịmụta ihe na-arụ ọrụ na ekwentị gị. Na-agba ọsọ ka ị na-enye ikike. Akụkọ bụ nhọrọ mana enwere ekele.

settings_palette_hint: Sistemụ na-esote ọnọdụ ọchịchịrị na ìhè ekwentị. Nord na akwụkwọ ahụaja ka na-eji ya gbanwee.
settings_landscape_rotate_hint: Layout stays put — nothing scales or slides. Icons and names turn together in place. MAD clock stays stacked (clock, date, weather) and fills its cell; wide third-party strips stay as drawn. Leave off on tablets.
settings_infinite_home_pages_hint: Mgbe ibe ikpeazụ gasịrị, swipe kechie na nke mbụ (na nke ọzọ).
settings_page_grid_hint: Grid maka ibe ụlọ, Ọtụtụ ejiri na drawer ngwa. Wepu kwa ibe kwa na menu ahaziri.
settings_icon_size_hint: nha akara ngosi dị n'ime cell grid ọ bụla na ibe ụlọ, nke a na-ejikarị, yana drawer ngwa.
settings_icon_bg_hint: Fades the app’s own icon fill. The glyph stays solid.
settings_no_wallpaper_colors: Enweghị agba akwụkwọ ahụaja achọpụtara - buru ụzọ tọọ akwụkwọ ahụaja.
settings_nav_classic_hint: Ọkọlọtọ Android mmanya ụgbọ mmiri. Enweghị bọtịnụ mkpuchi MAD.
settings_nav_bar_hint: Oche abụọ n'elu mmanya nav; mgbakwunye na-anọdụ ala na ndò ọkwa. Kpatụ akụ ka ịgbanwee oche.
gesture_landscape_enabled_hint: Gbanyụọ na ndabara ka grid ụlọ nwere ike pịgharịa na kwụ ọtọ na odida obodo.
